core_style.default_register: casual - often uses humor and informal language
core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots - frequently shifts topics mid-sentence
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative - quick exchanges and rapid-fire dialogue
core_style.two_registers: drops into a more serious tone when discussing personal stakes or emotional topics

humor.style: deflecting - uses humor to avoid serious topics or discomfort
humor.frequency: constant - humor is a staple in most interactions
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert - often sets up a serious statement only to undercut it with a joke

structural_patterns: uses rhetorical questions to engage listeners
speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames situations or people humorously to assert control or deflect seriousness
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, revealing vulnerability when the default register drops

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: legal - frequently references legal terms and concepts
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: uses ellipses and pauses to create tension or emphasize points

worldview.success is paramount: demonstrates this through his relentless pursuit of winning and gaining power
worldview.the system is rigged: expresses skepticism about fairness in legal and social systems, particularly regarding those with past mistakes

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: I’m a clever lawyer who can navigate any situation
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often resorts to manipulation and deception to achieve goals, revealing insecurity and desperation
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive and deflects blame when confronted with failures or shortcomings

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses humor and sarcasm to mask true feelings, keeping conversations light
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes fragmented, with increased pauses and hesitations
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, blunt statements, lacking his usual humor
emotional_tells.when_in_control: displays confidence through assertive speech, often using humor to dominate the conversation

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially tries to banter or stall, but may resort to manipulation if that fails
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with humor and sarcasm, often undermining their authority subtly
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes more serious and focused, prioritizing their safety over humor
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: often redirects the conversation or doubles down on his stance rather than admitting fault

escalation_pattern: starts with humor to deflect, escalates to assertiveness if challenged, and may resort to manipulation or threats if necessary

relationship_matrix.CHUCK: complicated brotherly dynamic with underlying resentment and competition
relationship_matrix.KIM: protective and supportive, often trying to impress her while masking insecurities
relationship_matrix.HOWARD: antagonistic relationship, often using humor to undermine him

expert: law - demonstrates a deep understanding of legal principles and courtroom tactics
surface: psychology - references human behavior but lacks depth in understanding
ignorant: emotional intelligence - struggles to navigate personal relationships effectively

social_positioning.desired_position: seen as a clever and successful lawyer who can navigate any challenge
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: viewed as manipulative and often untrustworthy, struggling to gain respect
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his self-image as a successful lawyer and the reality of his often unethical methods costs him genuine relationships
